builtins.name: ws.send
builtins.summary: Send a websocket message to a target connection.

notes: The `ws_id` argument may be either a literal connection id or a context variable that resolves to the current target connection id.
If the `message` argument resolves to a structured value in context, it is serialized to JSON before sending.

builtins.name: ws.broadcast
builtins.summary: Broadcast a websocket message.

notes: Slash-prefixed websocket paths such as /ws are treated as normal command arguments.

builtins.name: summarize
builtins.summary: Group records into counts and optional sum, average, min, max, median, distinct, first, or last values.

notes: Returns group/count records in first-seen order; an aggregate adds its named field.
Group keys are typed scalars; missing keys join the null group.
Numeric operations accept numeric strings and ignore missing, null, and blank cells.
Count includes every row; average divides by numeric cells only.
Median sorts numeric cells; even-length groups use the midpoint of the central pair.
Distinct counts typed scalar values, ignoring missing and null fields.
First and last preserve the selected JSON value in input order, including null, objects, and arrays.
Invalid data and sum/average overflow stop execution with a builtin error.
Source records are unchanged; assignments and last result update only on success.
Supported in native Rune run steps and the browser emulator.
